entity.summary: Self-custody cold-storage wallet ecosystem from CompoSecure built around an NFC secure-element card and mobile application.
entity.notes: Arculus first-party history explicitly states the Arculus brand and Cold Storage Wallet launched in 2021.

products.summary: Arculus self-custody cold-storage wallet combining an NFC secure-element card with the Arculus mobile app and three-factor authentication.
products.notes: Arculus first-party history states the Cold Storage Wallet launched in 2021. Current official product page lists stock, price and Buy Now controls, supporting on_sale.

events.title: Arculus documented Wallet 3.12.x as the current release
events.description: Arculus official update documentation identified Wallet 3.12.x as the current release by 2026-08-23 and listed 3.12.0 features. The source publication date is used as a conservative discovery date and does not assert that 3.12.0 itself was released on that day.

evidence.title: About Arculus
evidence.notes: First-party Arculus history states Arculus launched in 2021 with the Arculus Cold Storage Wallet and that users control their private keys.

evidence.title: Arculus Cold Storage Wallet
evidence.notes: Current official product page establishes self-custody, card/app architecture, current stock and purchase availability.

evidence.title: Arculus Wallet New Features
evidence.notes: First-party support documentation identifies 3.12.x as the current release; publication date is used only as discovery chronology.
